subject.title: feat(slack): render native charts from portable presentations

question: Should this PR require uploaded redacted native Slack chart proof before merge, or may maintainers accept the private Slack attestation as sufficient?
rationale: The implementation appears coherent and the API direction was stated in PR discussion, but ClawSweeper cannot independently verify the central Slack runtime behavior from a private uninspectable run.

options.title: Require Inspectable Slack Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted screenshot, recording, transcript, log, or live-output artifact showing a portable chart rendering natively in Slack before merge.

options.title: Accept Private Attestation
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly waive the public proof gap and own the remaining runtime verification risk for native Slack charts.

options.title: Pause If Proof Cannot Be Shared
options.body: If no redacted Slack artifact can be provided or waived, pause the PR under the broader Slack rich-output umbrella.

recommendation.title: Require Inspectable Slack Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted screenshot, recording, transcript, log, or live-output artifact showing a portable chart rendering natively in Slack before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They posted the exact-head evidence/API decision and are the strongest current owner visible for this PR's chart presentation surface.
